title: An empty track looks like a place to drop a clip
goal: A new video from an empty timeline shows its V1 and Audio lanes as bare background, the same as empty time, so a first-time user is not told where a clip goes until they are already dragging one. The mock draws an empty lane as a dashed, hatched slot. Draw empty lanes that way until something lands on them.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, the New video step 1 frame: empty V1 and Audio lanes dashed and hatched. App: /tmp/photonz-playtest/new-empty-video-walk/2-empty-video-sc.png (bare lanes, grid lines only) and 5-tile-over-v1-sc.png (the dashed preview appears only during a drag). Flag FeatureCatalog.blankVideoFlag, enabledByDefaultIn [.next]. Track lanes draw in Sources/Photonz/TimelineTrackRows.swift. Reuse the drag preview's dash style so the two read as one idea. A slot is drawn chrome, not a new control, so no card. Searched: empty lane, empty track, dashed lane: nothing.
acceptance: File > New Video shows its empty V1 and Audio lanes as the mock's dashed slots, and the audit has them beside video.html's New video step
The slot goes the moment a clip lands on the lane and comes back if the last clip leaves it, with undo
An empty track added with + on a video that already has clips shows the same slot
The drop preview while dragging is unchanged
Ships at Next defaults (next-blank-video is on in Next); the try path is: File > New Video, keep the default size, look at the timeline, then drag a Library tile onto V1
audit written under queue/audits/ in light and dark, and anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar and written into this task log if it does not

log.note: reproduced: /tmp/photonz-playtest/new-empty-video-walk/2-empty-video-sc.png shows bare lanes. Adversarial pass: a Premiere/FCP user sees empty tracks as drop targets already; the risk is a slot that reads as a locked hatch, so the slot uses filled 6pt stripes under a dashed edge (mock .lane.empty) while a locked track keeps its thin-line hatch and no slot. Built TimelineEmptySlot (TimelineLaneDrop.swift), shown when TimelineTrackRowModel.showsEmptySlot (no clips, no linked sound, no inner rows, not Captions, not locked); hidden while a carried clip lights the whole lane. New walk empty-track-slot-walk: new video slots dark+light, ghost over slot, landed (clip + its sound fill V1 and Audio), undo brings slots back, redo, Add Track gives a V2 slot. Both it and new-empty-video-walk pass; Scripts/test.sh 11562 tests pass.

left rough: while a file is held over a slot the rest of the lane stays striped where the mock's step 3 lights the whole lane; kept per this task's 'drop preview unchanged'. Not filed: the user can react on the audit line.

Empty lanes now draw the mock's dashed, striped slot (TimelineEmptySlot in TimelineLaneDrop.swift, gated by TimelineTrackRowModel.showsEmptySlot). Goes when a clip lands, back on undo, also on a track added with Add Track; drop ghost unchanged. Verified at Next defaults by empty-track-slot-walk (7 real captures, dark and light) and new-empty-video-walk; Scripts/test.sh green. Audit: queue/audits/2026-10-06-empty-track-slot.json with the mock frame beside it.

daily digest 2026-10-07: departure from the mock left standing: video.html's New video step 3 lights the whole lane while a file is held over it; the app draws a ghost only as long as the clip and the rest of the lane keeps its stripes (audit 2026-10-06-empty-track-slot, rough 3). The ghost says more than the mock's light, so not filed; if the user asks for the mock's look, this is where it came from.
